_comment: Deterministic payee rules, evaluated in order. First match wins. 'treatment' decides where a row lands: pl = profit & loss, equity/asset/liability = balance sheet only, transfer = excluded entirely, exception = never auto-decided, always routed to a human.

rules.note: Property-manager remittance. NET of PM fees - the CPA needs Certified Proper's annual statement to gross up rent and deduct management fees separately.
SALE PROCEEDS, NOT REVENUE. Mercury tagged this Revenue and that is wrong. Goes on Form 4797 net of basis and selling costs. Needs the closing statement.
Dreamhomes pass-through. Received AFTER the 1109 sale closed, then swept straight out. Almost certainly not 1109 income. Whose is it?
Principal + interest + escrow in one payment. ONLY the interest is deductible. Needs Form 1098 from Mr. Cooper to split. Loan is in Luis Vento's name - confirm the subject-to structure.
$458.33/mo to the seller of record on a loan still in his name. Interest? Principal? Lease payment? Mercury guessed 'Employee Benefits' which is certainly wrong.
Monthly payments to a partner. If Cobblestone is a LENDER not a partner these are interest expense instead - confirm which.
Received a distribution labelled 'partner distribution for sale of property' but this entity was never named as a 1109 partner. Who is this?
Ron is your 50/50 Thor Legacy partner. Labelled '400 Waterside'. Rehab reimbursement, contractor pay (1099!), or partner draw? Three very different answers.
Contractor - check 1099-NEC threshold across the full year.
Micro-deposit account verification, nets to zero. Noise - confirm and drop.
